_comment: SYNTHETIC portfolio. Every condition id, slug and title here is invented for
this demonstration; none of it is an observed position and none of it belongs
to any account. The shape is real: it is the row format the multi-tenant layer
and the public data API both produce, so the same file format works against
live data without changing a line of code.
Three groups, chosen to exercise three different paths through the exposure
synthetic-league-winner  a mutually exclusive group. Four NO legs on a
five-way race: at most one of them can lose, so the
true exposure is far below the sum of the costs.
synthetic-policy-rate    two legs on one event that are NOT mutually
exclusive. No structural identity applies, so the
conservative assumption is that they lose together.
standalone               one independent leg: exposure is simply its cost.
